## ecmcELM7222-0010_OPT.cmd

[Source: hardware/Beckhoff_7XXX/ELM/ecmcELM7222-0010_OPT.cmd](https://github.com/paulscherrerinstitute/ecmccfg/blob/master/hardware/Beckhoff_7XXX/ELM/ecmcELM7222-0010_OPT.cmd)

Documented configuration options:

- MODE CSV (default), CSP, CST or CSTCA; MODE_1/MODE_2 override per channel
- TP Touch-probe status PDO, default 0; supported: 1
- INFO2 Default NONE; see hugo/content/manual/knowledgebase/hardware/EX72xx_OPT.md for capabilities
- DIAG Actual velocity, torque and voltage PDOs, default 0
- ENC_STAT 0 or 1; default 1
